messages:
Claudia: Zenith Micro EAP NDA is signed — good news. Need to finalize bench matrix and shipping details.
Zenith-poc: We'll ship 5 modules next Wed. Driver image `zenith-rt-2026.img` + reference container will be on our partner portal. Will DM vault token.
Tom: Bench focus request from partner: int8 perf, latency under contention, and thermal profile. Also they asked for a short partner-ready summary doc.
Raj: Proposed bench runs: latency sweep (seq 32/128/512), contention test (multi-tenant sim), quant int8 accuracy sweep. Use `rbench` harness.
Ops-Lee: Need exact commands to bake into infra job and the image SHA for the golden container. Also egress exception to fetch partner artifacts.
Raj: Example commands:
```
rbench --model rwd-v1-7b --mode latency --seq 128 --batch 4 --out s3://bench/zenith/1873456789/latency
rbench --model rwd-v1-7b --mode contention --clients 4 --seq 512 --batch 8 --out s3://bench/zenith/1873456789/contention
rbench --model rwd-v1-7b --mode quant --quant int8 --out s3://bench/zenith/1873456789/quant
```
Legal-bot: NDA flagged firmware and microcode as restricted. Partner copy must be scrubbed — remove kernel oops, microcode traces. Allowed: perf counters, power, temps.
Claudia: Important: bench outputs uploaded to partner buckets must be scrubbed first. Raj, please add `--strip-firmware` to the harness.
Raj: Will add `--strip-firmware --anonymize` and a postprocess step that retains only counters + aggregated latencies.
Bench-bot: Latency pass queued on infra-gpu-15. Est run ~2h. Artifacts -> s3://bench/zenith/1873456789/runmeta.json when done.
Bench-bot: Latency pass complete. Summary: seq32 p50=3.4ms p99=11.0ms; seq512 p50=13.2ms p99=50.6ms. Contention run queued.
Zenith-poc: We'll provide a power helper and a smoke-test script. Shipping ETA confirmed.
Ops-Lee: I'll request egress exception and bake the golden image once we have the SHA.
Claudia: Action items: (1) Zenith upload driver/container + smoke test (zenith-poc), (2) Ops bake golden image + egress (ops-lee), (3) Raj run contention + quant and produce internal + scrubbed partner report, (4) Legal review partner copy (legal-bot). Quick sync Fri 9am PT to review scrubbed results and decide marketing preview.
Tom: Noted. If blockers, post here. :rocket:
